units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:7">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>מן השמים ירחמו</he> from heaven they will have mercy (on me), i.e. I trust in God.

<cite ref="Shabbat 21b:5">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>המהדרין מן המהדרין</he> v. <cite ref="E00147"><he>הָדַר</he></cite>.—<he>מן המובחר</he>, v. <cite ref="B00483"><he>בָּחַר</he></cite>; <he>מן המומחה</he>, v. <cite ref="M00520"><he>מוּמְחֶה</he></cite>.—

Tem. 28ᵃ מן הבהמה להוציא וכ׳ ‘of the cattle’ (Lev. I, 2) intimates the exclusion of &c.; a. v. fr.—Prefix מִ־, מָי־, מֵ־, מֵי־ q. v.—מִנַּיִן, מִנַּיִין, מִינַּיִין (= b. h. מֵאַיִן, v. אַיִן) whence?, whence is it proven?—

<cite ref="Yoma 32a">Yoma 32ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ לחמש וכ׳</he> whence is derived the regulation about five immersions &c.? <cite ref="Yoma 32a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ומ׳ שכל טבילה וכ׳</he> and whence is the rule derived that each immersion requires &c.? <cite ref="Yoma 44a:1">Ib. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>אין לי אלא … מ׳</he> this would prove to me only in favor of …, whence do you derive that the same applies to …?; a. v. fr.
